title: Modbus TCP field protocol is unauthenticated by design
detail: The southbound Modbus/TCP link cannot authenticate or integrity-protect frames. Compensating controls: gateway acts as the only conduit into the cell zone (IEC 62443-3-3 zones/conduits), simulator/devices bound to the control VLAN, strict response validation in ModbusFrame. Roadmap: Modbus/TCP Security (TLS, port 802) for devices that support it.

title: Device-side firmware authenticity depends on the device bootloader
detail: The gateway verifies signature, model binding and anti-rollback before staging. The final flash step must be verified again by the device (secure boot); this belongs to the device's own CRA assessment.

title: Client certificate allow-list requires lifecycle management
detail: Certificate rotation, revocation (CRL/OCSP reachable from the OT network) and allow-list updates are documented in the secure configuration guide; an expired or revoked certificate fails closed.

title: Firmware/license signing key held as PEM in the POC
detail: fg-sign reads a PEM private key for demonstration. Production signing must use an HSM / Azure Key Vault key with dual control; only public keys are deployed to gateways.
